# Getting help

- **How do I…? / Does heavyq fit my setup?** Ask in
  [Discussions](https://github.com/LysCongThanh/heavyq/discussions) (Q&A).
- **Something behaves wrongly:** open a [bug report](https://github.com/LysCongThanh/heavyq/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml)
  with the output of `heavyq status` while it misbehaves.
- **An idea:** float it in Discussions first, then a
  [feature request](https://github.com/LysCongThanh/heavyq/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml).
- **A security problem:** never in public. See [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).

Before asking, check the [README](../README.md) and
[docs/](../docs/) (flags, config table, exit codes).
